plan.reason: The forecast shows a cold day with temperatures ranging from -7.0°C to 3.6°C, indicating that the core zones will likely need cooling due to solar gain and occupancy. Given the warmest zone temperature of 22.4°C now and considering the worst excursion was 5.49 K over 24 hours at a ceiling of 16.8°C, it's clear that lowering the supply air temperature to 13.0°C would be too high for comfort as zones will likely exceed the core mid zone temperature by more than 3.57 K.
